WITH sales AS (
  SELECT
    b."HĐ" AS "order_id",
    CAST(b."Ngày" AS DATE) AS "order_date",
    b."Ngày" AS "order_ts",
    NULL AS "product_code",
    COALESCE(d."Tên hàng", b."Tên hàng") AS "product_name",
    d."Nhóm" AS "product_group",
    b."SL" AS "qty",
    b."ĐVT" AS "unit",
    b."TT" AS "amount",
    NULL AS "customer_id",
    CASE 
      WHEN LOWER(TRIM(b."Khách")) IN ('khách lẻ', 'kl', 'lẻ', 'vãng lai', '') THEN NULL 
      ELSE b."Khách" 
    END AS "customer_name",
    NULL AS "staff",
    b."Kênh" AS "channel",
    NULL AS "payment",
    b."_don_huy" AS "is_cancelled",
    b."_don_tra" AS "is_returned",
    CASE 
      WHEN b."Tên hàng" LIKE 'Voucher' 
        OR b."Tên hàng" LIKE 'Dùng % điểm' 
        OR b."Tên hàng" LIKE 'Phí ship' 
      THEN 'adjust' 
      ELSE 'item' 
    END AS "line_kind",
    b."Tên hàng" AS "_raw_product_name"
  FROM "banhang_all" b
  LEFT JOIN "quanly_danhmuc" d ON b."Tên hàng" = d."Tên hàng"
)
SELECT
  "order_id",
  "order_date",
  "order_ts",
  "product_code",
  "product_group",
  "product_name",
  "qty",
  "unit",
  "amount",
  "customer_id",
  "customer_name",
  "staff",
  "channel",
  "payment",
  "is_cancelled",
  "is_returned",
  "line_kind"
FROM sales
ORDER BY "order_id", "order_date"
